apis.ref: get|{{leavebaseurl}}|/user/leaves/getallleavereports|leave api|tc01/tc03 - get all leave reports and validate structure
apis.authProviderApiId: post|{{authbaseurl}}|/auth/token|employee auth api|tc01 - valid credentials return jwt token

definition.Purpose: Return every leave request for a month and year, with aggregate status counts

payloads.Sample JSON: {"status": "success", "errorCode": null, "message": "Leave report fetched successfully", "data": {"count": {"approved": 12, "pending": 3, "cancelled": 1, "rejected": 2}, "leaveReport": [{"lr_no": 1042, "lr_id": 5311, "subject": "Sick Leave", "application_date": "15-Apr-2026", "status": "Approved", "start_date": "17-Apr-2026", "end_date": "17-Apr-2026", "leave_type": "Sick Leave", "emp_name": "Sample Employee", "day_type": "Full Day", "empid": 4471, "purpose": "Medical appointment", "reason": "Approved by reporting manager"}]}, "timestamp": "04-Aug-2026 T09:53:23"}
{"status": "error", "errorCode": "INVALID_MONTH", "message": "Month must be between 1 and 12.", "data": null, "timestamp": "04-Aug-2026 T09:53:23"}

rules.Description: month must be between 1 and 12; year is a four-digit calendar year.
purpose and reason may be null for bulk or administratively created entries.
Requires a valid Bearer token from POST /auth/token before it can be called.
A month with no leave requests returns an empty leaveReport array with zeroed counts.
An invalid month returns HTTP 400 with errorCode INVALID_MONTH.
Read-only endpoint; safe to call repeatedly. Observed responses are large for busy months.
